verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Cloud publishing MCP servers, such as the Cloud Run MCP server and MCP Toolbox for Databases, which other MCP clients connect to. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing in the pack documents Google Cloud or Vertex AI consuming external MCP servers as a client. The Vertex AI 'agentic systems' marketing never mentions plugging in MCP servers, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
